Remark
[Frankel's theorem]

Source: petersen:page-0282 ↗ lem:pet-ch6-wilking-connectedness-principle Part (b) of section 5, in the special case that only nonemptiness of $N_1\cap N_2$ is retained, is classically known as Frankel’s theorem: two closed totally geodesic submanifolds $N_1,N_2$ of a manifold of positive curvature with $\dim N_1+\dim N_2\ge \dim M$ must intersect.
